scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm --filter @gwonmac/tools-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @gwonmac/launcher-ui typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @gwonmac/tools-ui test && pnpm --filter @gwonmac/launcher-ui test
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm build && node scripts/verify-companion-kernel.mjs && node scripts/verify-cartography-reachability-kernel.mjs && node --import ./scripts/ts-hook.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/integration/*.ts tests/release/*.ts && pnpm --filter @gwonmac/tools-ui test:e2e && pnpm test:electron && node scripts/clean-output.mjs && electron-forge package && node --import ./scripts/ts-hook.mjs tests/packaged-smoke.ts && node --import ./scripts/ts-hook.mjs tests/packaged-enhancement-runtime.ts
scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/verify-companion-kernel.mjs && node scripts/verify-cartography-reachability-kernel.mjs && node scripts/clean-output.mjs && electron-forge package
scripts.make: pnpm build && node scripts/clean-output.mjs && electron-forge make
